svg.title: MediaLog — The one-timeline setup wizard
svg.desc: The one-timeline setup wizard. A media diary you share: everything you have watched, read, played and listened to, on one timeline. The wizard collects the six supported media types in their screenshot-inspired colours. Its steps are when, how it was and share; approximate dates remain welcome. Decorative interface examples.
svg.text: Film. Book. Show. Game. Album. Podcast.
Precise date or “sometime”. Your words. Your people.
